info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Utility Billing Estimates-v1-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Estimates Retrieval API enables users to access projected utility billing estimates for various services. This endpoint provides detailed insights into expected costs based on usage patterns and historical data. Typical consumers of this API include utility companies, customer service platforms, and financial forecasting applications that require accurate billing projections. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance customer experience and streamline budgeting processes for utility expenses.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain an estimate of their billing based on specific parameters. The estimate reflects potential charges and is useful for budgeting and planning purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary parameters for generating a billing estimate. Ensure all required fields are included to obtain an accurate estimate based on the input provided.

ListUtilityBillingEstimatesRequest.description: This schema represents the JSON request body for the GET operation related to billing estimates.
